description: Collect LinkedIn job postings as structured data with the harshmaur/linkedin-jobs-scraper Apify Actor: search by job title and location, or pass LinkedIn job search URLs, and get title, company, location, posting date, full description (text, Markdown, HTML), seniority, employment type, applicant count, salary with parsed min and max, the recruiter who posted the job, and optional company size, website and headquarters. Use when the user says "scrape LinkedIn jobs", "find data engineer jobs in Berlin posted this week", "export LinkedIn job listings to CSV", "who is hiring for X", "salary ranges for X on LinkedIn", "get the recruiter for these jobs", "daily LinkedIn job alert", "build a job board feed", or "companies hiring X in <country>". No LinkedIn account, cookies or API access is needed. Out of scope: applying to jobs, messaging recruiters, LinkedIn profiles, posts or people search.
